text:
Maria (People Ops): Quick blocker: three new interviewers completed the 'Panel Interviewer 101' training but the ATS still shows them as 'not cleared' and they can't be assigned to interviews. Anyone seen this linkage fail?
Sam (Recruiting Ops): I noticed one earlier. The ATS expects a boolean flag interviewer_approved=true from the training pipeline webhook. Looks like the webhook delivered 200 but the ATS didn't update.
Ravi (Learning): The LMS shows completions for Aisha, Marco, and Devin with timestamps this morning. Our webhook logs show delivery to /api/integrations/training at 09:12, 09:18, 09:22 and response 200. Payload looks fine.
Ashley (SRE): Can you paste a sample payload? Also check whether there was any recent change to the ATS integration endpoint auth.
Ravi (Learning): Sample: {user_email: "aisha@example.com", course: "Panel Interviewer 101", status: "completed", timestamp: "2026-03-23T09:12:00Z"}. Sent with HMAC header.
Sam (Recruiting Ops): Our ingestion service validates HMAC then upserts into user_flags. I see logs: "webhook accepted" but later a constraint error when upserting user_flags for newly created accounts (unique index violation on user_id when user record partially created). Looks like race: org provisioning creates user row after LMS webhook, causing the upsert to fail silently.
Lee (Recruiter): For affected folks, can we manually flip the cleared flag? We're blocked on scheduling panel interviews.
Ashley (SRE): We should avoid manual DB edits if possible. Quick mitigation: retry webhook deliveries from LMS for the three emails (Ravi can requeue) while we patch the ingestion to retry on constraint errors. I'll open a short-lived fix to catch the unique violation and retry after a brief backoff.
Ravi (Learning): I can re-send the three payloads now. Re-send queued.

onboarding-bot: webhook.requeue 1: payloads=3 user_emails=["aisha@example.com","marco@example.com","devin@example.com"]
Sam (Recruiting Ops): After Ravi re-sent, I see the ingestion created the flags for Aisha and Marco but Devin still failed due to a missing user_id mapping (we rely on email->user lookup and Devin's account used an alternate corporate email).
Lee (Recruiter): Devin used devin+recruit@personal.org for training signup, but ATS has devin@company.com. Can we map aliases?
Sam (Recruiting Ops): We have an alias table but the ingestion only checks primary email. Short term: I can manually add alias mapping for Devin so ingestion will upsert. Long term: ingestion should check alias table too.
Ashley (SRE): I'll deploy the ingestion retry fix in the next 15 minutes (low-risk). Sam, pls add a ticket to expand email lookup to aliases and make the webhook idempotent. Ravi, requeue complete?
Ravi (Learning): Requeue finished and I also emailed the three with instructions to re-open their onboarding checklist if still blocked.
Sam (Recruiting Ops): Manual alias added for Devin, ingestion now shows interviewer_approved=true for all three. Verified they can be assigned to interviews.
Maria (People Ops): Great. Action items: Ashley to deploy ingestion retry fix (in progress), Sam to file enhancement ticket for alias lookup and idempotency, Ravi to add a note in training docs recommending corporate email during signup, Lee to follow up with hiring teams. Aim to close today.
Sam (Recruiting Ops): Ticket filed: REQ-3521 "Training webhook: alias lookup + idempotent upsert".
Ashley (SRE): Ingestion retry deployed, monitoring looks clean.
Maria (People Ops): Thanks all 60; marking resolved and will notify the interview coordinators that new interviewers are cleared.
